text_block_list.text:
When I contacted Duramente on business, she replied, "I'm in the kitchen. Sorry, but my hands are full."
Heading over to the kitchen—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you came.
Sorry for making you go out of your way.
choice_data_list: No... what's up with this food?

text_block_list.text: A massive spread of dishes was lined up in front of Duramente. It was an extraordinary amount of food.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I was putting together a trial menu
tailored to your training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This menu is for the body-building phase.
Focus on getting protein from meat, fish, eggs, and soy.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"The ones in the back are for the weight-cut phase.
I've increased the vegetables and seaweed."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Next to that are the ones for improving endurance, pre-race, and post-race.
choice_data_list: Incredible... The nutritional balance is absolute perfection.
Amazing... The nutritional balance is totally perfect!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Additionally, in case ingredients aren't available,
I've prepared three different menu options for each.
Any nutritional variance has also been kept within margin of error.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let us taste it, then.
There is no point if it is not a flavor one can keep eating, after all.
choice_data_list: This ridiculous amount... are you really gonna eat it all?
This ridiculous amount... are you going to eat it all?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: You'll end up overeating, so let's keep it to a moderate amount.
Whether you can actually finish it all is important too!
Whether you can actually finish it all is important too!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: You'll end up overeating, so let's keep it to a moderate amount.
Whether you can actually finish it all is important too!
Whether you can actually finish it all is important too!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Still, we cannot let food go to waste.
Would you eat with me?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind, I'd like to hear what you think of the flavor.
Duramente tasted a little bit of each prototype dish.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
If the seasoning is too strong or too weak and they can't finish it, that defeats the whole purpose.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'm checking whether the flavor holds up
and stays delicious until the very last bite.

After that, Duramente devoured
the massive spread of food all by herself.
